context.decisions: Carry forward settled scope: reuse #272 transport, binding, mode profiles, shared validation and the server-held private creation permit; do not reintroduce an agent-carried token. The elevated grant applies to creation-class operations, not ordinary issues_comment on an already-authorized existing target. #273 owns registration, tool semantics and controlled-fixture tests. #274 owns production host integration and remaining production lifecycle wiring, and is not a prerequisite. Run-4 recommendations are candidates to verify against the actual primitive rather than instructions to change its authorization or identity semantics. Verified correction to run-4 feedback: the canonical content hash binds approval to reviewed content and must not replace operation/request identity. Existing creation reservation recovery uses the grant identity after exact envelope verification; submission journaling separately preserves stable request identity. Verified recommendations (unapplied): US-005 AC-002 should explicitly cover the loaded allow_mcp_story_creation setting omitted or false; config.Defaults already defaults false, so this is family regression coverage. For US-005 AC-003, explicitly state that submission.CanonicalCreation recomputes the reviewed envelope canonical hash and exact bytes; caller hashes do not replace verification. For US-005 AC-004, state that exact-envelope retries under the same live grant recover the existing CreationOperation through grant-scoped reservation, with receipt correlation referencing it rather than substituting hash-only deduplication. US-004 architecture can name github.Client.PostComment, redactor-produced redact.Body, a new embedded migration and internal/store accessors, bounded observation, and no turn retry loop or periodic worker. These are already covered by its criteria and shared architecture, so additional ACs are unnecessary. Optional navigation improvements: US-001 name submission.Call, its journal and store.CreationOperation references; US-003 preserve the daemon ListIssues method, add a bounded page accessor, and reuse GetIssue with state checks/minimal projection. Existing shared context already assigns production host launch, scope construction and lifecycle scheduling to #274; local reminders in US-001/002/004/007 are optional, not missing scope. Optional explanatory prose: Preflight checks proposed input before submission; activity describes the agent current reported progress; receipts recover what the factory knows happened to a specific request. These distinctions already have acceptance coverage.
